svg.text: MLIR AI Compiler · Multi-Stream Execution Pipeline
Static Graph Optimization → Runtime Scheduling → Hardware Concurrency → Memory Reuse
Graph Optimization — Compile-time · Static DAG & Fusion
Operator fusion · algebraic reordering · parallel-branch detection
Data-independent branches tagged as stream-concurrency candidates → overlapped at
Runtime Scheduling — Async Launch · Priority · Load Balance
Host launch / device-exec split · work stealing for dynamic shapes
Async Launch · Priority Preemption · Work Stealing
Host enqueues kernels non-blocking; high-prio comm stream preempts; idle SMs steal tasks
Device queues throttle host when saturated; CUDA-graph capture amortizes per-kernel
Hardware Concurrency — Multi-Stream Overlap · SM Partition
GPU SM array · timeline swimlanes · MPS / MIG spatial multiplexing
Memory Pool — Lifetime · In-place · Workspace Reuse
Add / ReLU overwrite the input buffer → zero extra
Operators share one scratch buffer → ↓ allocation
Next kernel consumes output while still warm in L2
t0 alloc K1 → t1 in-place ReLU → t2 workspace reused by K2 → t3 free (ring arcs = ownership)
